method: For each character in ciphertext, find its index in the keyed alphabet KRYPTOSABCDEFGHIJLMNQUVWXZ, subtract the index of the corresponding key character (repeating PALIMPSEST with period 10), take modulo 26, and convert back to uppercase A-Z. Applied to all 63 ciphertext characters.

indicator_keyword = "PALIMPSEST"
period = 10
keyed_alphabet = "KRYPTOSABCDEFGHIJLMNQUVWXZ"

plaintext_chars = []
for i in range(len(ct)):
    ct_char = ct[i]
    key_char = indicator_keyword[i % period]
